title_en: Winter Session 2026 Field Practice 3 Internship Applications (October 26–30)
summary: Students interested in the Winter Session 2026 internship-semester course Field Practice 3 (현장실습 3) may apply by emailing the signed application form to the Department of Naval Architecture and Ocean Engineering office (Building 34, Room 417). The first application round runs from October 26 to October 30, 2026, and a possible second round runs from November 10 to November 11, 2026. Applicants must also register for the course and must not take any other Winter Session course.
applies_to: Students interested in the Winter Session 2026 internship-semester course Field Practice 3 (현장실습 3), announced by the Department of Naval Architecture and Ocean Engineering. Application is voluntary. Students who take part must register for the course.

dates.what: First-round application submission period (deadlines strictly observed)
Second-round application submission period (may not take place, depending on first-round selection results)

conditions: Field Practice 3 combines the internship with course attendance, so participants must register for the course.
Participants may not take any other Winter Session course, including online (remote) courses.
Any other Winter Session courses a participant has already registered for will be cancelled.
Course registration and tuition payment dates for this course may differ from the regular schedule, so participants must check the separate notice.
Students who abandon the internship partway or participate insincerely will not receive credit, and payment of the internship allowance may be restricted.
The application form must include the applicant's signature at the bottom.
The second-round selection may not take place, depending on the first-round selection results.
steps: Read Attachment 1 (the list of internship host institutions), which also contains the table that may not display in the notice; the attachment's content was not read for this translation.
Read Attachment 3 (Hanwha Ocean job-by-job duty descriptions) to help you fill in your preferred job field; its content was not read for this translation.
Complete Attachment 2, the Field Practice 3 participation application form (Hanwha Ocean), and sign at the bottom of the form.

Email the signed application form to the Department of Naval Architecture and Ocean Engineering office (Building 34, Room 417) during the first round (October 26–30, 2026) or, if held, the second round (November 10–11, 2026); the email address is in the original notice.
If selected, register for Field Practice 3 and pay tuition according to the separate notice on course registration and tuition payment.
translation:
Winter Session 2026 Internship Semester: Field Practice 3 (『현장실습 3』) Internship Application Guide (Application documents accepted October 26 (Mon) – October 30 (Fri))

We announce the internship application for the Winter Session 2026 internship-semester course Field Practice 3 (『현장실습 3』) as follows. Interested students are encouraged to apply.

Because Field Practice 3 combines the internship with course attendance, you must register for the course (수강신청), and you may not take any other Winter Session course (including online/remote courses). Any other courses you have already registered for will be cancelled. The course registration and tuition payment schedule may differ from the regular schedule, so be sure to check the separate notice.

Please note that if you abandon the internship partway or participate insincerely, no credit will be awarded and payment of the internship allowance may be restricted.

1. Course overview

2. Schedule

3. Internship host institutions (※ If the table below does not display, refer to the file "[Attachment 1]")

[Note: The content of sections 1 to 3 appears to have been provided as tables or images that are not in the notice text, so it was not read.]

4. How to submit the application: by email (including your signature at the bottom of the application form)

5. Application periods (deadlines strictly observed)
 - (1st round) 2026.10.26. (Mon) – 2026.10.30. (Fri)
 - (2nd round) 2026.11.10. (Tue) – 2026.11.11. (Wed) (※ Depending on the first-round selection results, the second-round selection may not take place.)

6. Submission and inquiries: Department of Naval Architecture and Ocean Engineering office (Building 34, Room 417). The contact person's email and phone number are in the original notice.

[Attachment 2] 2026 (Winter) Internship Semester_Field Practice 3_Participation Application Form (Hanwha Ocean)
